title: A Polynomial-Time Best-of-Both-Worlds Algorithm for Matroid Semi-Bandit Problems
abstract: arXiv:2611.30104v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader (FTPL) offers a computationally attractive framework for online learning, with recent advances establishing Best-of-Both-Worlds (BOBW) guarantees for various bandit settings. For matroid semi-bandits, existing methods offering such guarantees primarily rely on Follow-the-Regularized-Leader (FTRL), which requires solving an optimization problem at each round. We establish BOBW guarantees for FTPL with Fr\'echet and Pareto distributions with a certain parameter with geometric resampling in the matroid semi-bandit problem, showing that FTPL can simultaneously achieve the minimax-optimal $O(\sqrt{mdT})$ regret in adversarial setting and a logarithmic regret in stochastic setting. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first polynomial-time algorithm for matroid semi-bandits that achieves BOBW guarantees.

translated_title: 拟阵半老虎机问题的多项式时间“两全其美”算法
translated_abstract: 跟随扰动领导者（FTPL）为在线学习提供了一个计算上具有吸引力的框架，最近的进展已为各种老虎机设置建立了“两全其美”（BOBW）保证。对于拟阵半老虎机问题，提供此类保证的现有方法主要依赖于跟随正则化领导者（FTRL），该方法需要在每一轮求解一个优化问题。我们在拟阵半老虎机问题中，为采用特定参数的Fréchet分布和Pareto分布并结合几何重采样的FTPL建立了BOBW保证，结果表明FTPL能够在对抗性环境中同时实现极小极大最优的 $O(\sqrt{mdT})$ 遗憾，并在随机环境中实现对数级遗憾。据我们所知，这是首个实现BOBW保证的拟阵半老虎机多项式时间算法。
tldr: 本文基于结合Fréchet与Pareto扰动分布及几何重采样的FTPL算法，提出了首个具有多项式时间复杂度且能在对抗环境中达到极小极大最优遗憾、在随机环境中达到对数遗憾的“两全其美”拟阵半老虎机算法。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the first polynomial-time Best-of-Both-Worlds (BOBW) guarantee for matroid semi-bandits, showing that FTPL with Fréchet and Pareto distributions and geometric resampling achieves minimax-optimal $O(\sqrt{mdT})$ regret in adversarial settings and logarithmic regret in stochastic settings.
